resources.string: Circular-dot clock and serif date for your home screen.
Previews are rendered live in the app. When Alarms & reminders access is enabled, placed clocks use the dotted bitmap updated each minute; otherwise they use the live system text clock.
Alarms & reminders access is enabled. Placed clocks draw the circular-dot bitmap and refresh each minute.
Alarms & reminders access is off. Placed clocks use the live system text clock. This optional access only enables the dotted minute-update bitmap.
This Android version does not need Alarms & reminders access for dotted minute updates.

Tap to open this app\x2019s Alarms & reminders settings in Android; the app never grants access itself. You can revoke it at any time. Android cancels the app\x2019s updates when access is revoked, so a placed clock falls back to the live system text clock on its next update or resize.
Android settings could not be opened. Open App info > Alarms & reminders for Dotwel Widgets.
Long-press your home screen, open Widgets, then choose Dotwel Clock or Dotwel Date. Resize either widget from its handles. Style changes apply to every placed widget.
Original dot-matrix geometry and platform serif. Design inspired by Nothing OS; this app is not affiliated with Nothing Technology Limited.
A live stacked-hours-and-minutes clock. Dotted bitmap updates each minute when Alarms & reminders access is enabled, otherwise the system text clock is shown.
A live serif date with a red abbreviated weekday and black, translucent or transparent styling.
